intents.name: admission
examples: how can I apply for admission
do I need an entrance exam to join
which documents are required to apply
how to join the college after 12th
when do admissions open this year
can I get a seat with 55 percent
how do I apply for a PG course
intents.answer:
**Admissions (UG and PG)**

- **Applications open:** every March on the institute website
- **UG eligibility:** 12th pass with at least **50%** marks
- **PG eligibility:** a bachelor's degree with at least **50%** marks
- **Selection:** merit-based, using your qualifying marks
- **Documents:** marks cards, ID proof, passport photos and transfer certificate

**Next step:** fill the online form, upload your documents and pay the application fee of **₹500**.

Need help with the form? Call **080-0000-0000**.

intents.answer:
**Fee structure (per year)**

| Program | Tuition |
|---|---|
| UG (BCom, BBA, BCA, BSc) | ₹45,000 |
| PG (MBA, MCom, MSc) | ₹60,000 |

**Optional extras**
- Hostel with mess: ₹60,000 per year
- College bus: ₹12,000 per year

**How to pay:** online through the student portal (UPI, cards or net banking), in **two installments**: June and December.

A late fee of ₹100 per week applies after the due date.

intents.name: exams
examples: when will the hall ticket be released
how do I check my results
when is the exam form last date
how many exams in a year
when does the next semester start
intents.answer:
**Exams and results**

- **Semester exams:** November and May
- **Timetable and hall tickets:** published on the student portal **two weeks** before the exams
- **Results:** announced about **30 days** after the last exam
- **Revaluation:** apply within 7 days of the results, on the portal
- **Internal assessment:** 30% of the marks (tests and assignments)

The pass mark is **40%** in each subject.

intents.name: hostel
examples: how much is the hostel fee

intents.answer:
**Hostel facilities**

- Separate hostels for **boys and girls**, inside the campus
- **Fee:** ₹60,000 per year, including mess
- **Rooms:** 2 or 3 students sharing, with cots, study tables and wardrobes
- **Mess:** vegetarian meals, three times a day
- Wi-Fi, laundry and 24-hour security with a resident warden
- **Gate closes** at 9 PM for girls and 10 PM for boys

**To apply:** fill the hostel form on the student portal after your admission. Rooms are given on a first-come basis.

examples: how to apply for a scholarship

intents.answer:
**Scholarships and financial aid**

- **Merit scholarship:** up to **50%** tuition waiver for students scoring above 90%
- **Government scholarships:** SC/ST, OBC and minority scholarships are accepted
- **Sports quota:** 25% concession for state-level players
- **Education loans:** the office helps with bank paperwork

**To apply, bring:** your income certificate, caste certificate (if applicable) and last marks card to the office.

**Last date:** 30 days after the term begins.

intents.name: placements
examples: what is the highest salary package
intents.answer:
**Placements and careers**

- An active **placement cell** with campus drives every year
- **40+ companies** visit the campus
- **Training:** aptitude, communication, resume building and mock interviews
- **Internships** in the final year
- **Last year:** highest package ₹8 LPA, average ₹3.6 LPA

We provide placement support, but jobs are not guaranteed.

**Certificates and documents**

intents.answer:
**College bus service**

- **8 city routes**, morning pickup from **7:30 AM**
- Return buses leave at **4:30 PM** and **5:30 PM**
- **Fee:** ₹12,000 per year
- Bike and car **parking** is available on campus

**To register:** collect the bus form at the office and choose your pickup point. Route maps are on the notice board.

Your college ID card is your library card.
